name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 22 times in 7 visits over 60 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 42 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.5 days starting 2025-08-18, at wavelengths from 0.78 to 4.64 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
